item_name: Rothco Deluxe Swat Low Profile Cap
item_short_desc: Rothco’s Deluxe Swat Low Profile Cap, made from soft and durable cotton twill, features a raised 3-D embroidered “SWAT” text on the front panel as well as the brim and sandwich brim of the hat.
description: Rothco’s Deluxe Swat Low Profile Cap, made from soft and durable cotton twill, features a raised 3-D embroidered “SWAT” text on the front panel as well as the brim and sandwich brim of the hat. This police hat also features a hook and loop closure in the back for adjustability.
